# posts-service

A blogging backend.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs for the interactive OpenAPI UI.

## Test

```bash
ruff check . && pytest
```

## Container

```bash
docker build -t posts-service:local .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 posts-service:local
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/posts` | List posts |
| `POST` | `/posts` | Create a post |
| `GET` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Get one post |
| `PATCH` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Update a post |
| `DELETE` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Delete a post |
| `GET` | `/comments` | List comments |
| `POST` | `/comments` | Create a comment |
| `GET` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Get one comment |
| `PATCH` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Update a comment |
| `DELETE` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Delete a comment |

## Deployment

* `deploy/k8s/` - Kustomize base (Deployment, Service). Set `DATABASE_URL` through the
  referenced Secret.
* `deploy/terraform/` - AWS ECR + ECS Fargate service. Run `terraform init && terraform
  plan` with your own VPC and subnets; nothing is applied automatically.

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for components and design decisions.

"""Database engine, session factory and declarative base."""

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./app.db")

_connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False} if DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite") else {}
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args=_connect_args, pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

"""SQLAlchemy ORM models."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Post(Base):
    __tablename__ = "posts"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    published: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False)
    published_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Comment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "comments"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    author: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    approved: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)

"""Pydantic request/response schemas."""

from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class PostCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., max_length=255)
    body: str = Field(...)
    published: bool = Field(...)
    published_at: datetime | None = Field(None)


class PostUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = Field(None, max_length=255)
    body: str | None = Field(None)
    published: bool | None = Field(None)
    published_at: datetime | None = Field(None)


class PostRead(PostCreate):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    created_at: datetime


class CommentCreate(BaseModel):
    author: str = Field(..., max_length=255)
    body: str = Field(...)
    approved: bool = Field(...)


class CommentUpdate(BaseModel):
    author: str | None = Field(None, max_length=255)
    body: str | None = Field(None)
    approved: bool | None = Field(None)


class CommentRead(CommentCreate):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    created_at: datetime

"""Application entry point."""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.db import Base, engine
from app.routers import comments, posts


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Posts Service", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.include_router(posts.router)
app.include_router(comments.router)


@app.get("/healthz", tags=["ops"])
def healthz() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "example title",
    "body": "Some longer body text.",
    "published": True,
    "published_at": "2025-01-15T09:30:00Z",
}


def test_create_and_get_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["title"] == "example title"
    assert created["body"] == "Some longer body text."
    assert created["published"] is True
    fetched = client.get(f"/posts/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_post_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/posts", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(
        f"/posts/{created['id']}", json={"title": "updated title"}
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["title"] == "updated title"


def test_delete_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/posts/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/posts/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_post_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/posts/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_post_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/posts", json={}).status_code == 422

FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /src
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
RUN pip install .

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
RUN useradd --uid 10001 --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - name: Install
        run: pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check .
      - name: Test
        run: pytest -q

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: posts-service:${{ github.sha }}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: posts-service
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: posts-service
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: posts-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: posts-service
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: posts-service:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: posts-service-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
